_comment: Orchestra-managed Codex hooks file. CodexAdapter.prepareToLaunch renders this (replacing __ORCHESTRA_BIN__ with the live `orchestra` binary path and __AGENT_ID__ with the agent id) into dataDir/codex-hooks.json, then installs it into the pinned $CODEX_HOME/hooks.json (only when absent or already Orchestra's — never clobbering a foreign user hooks.json). SessionStart (Claude-parity) reads `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` for the card's column/mode/self-id orientation. Stop drains the card's durable inbox at turn-end via the shared adapter-free channel: handleHook(.stop) composes the drain, CodexAdapter.encode emits the {decision:block,reason} continuation (byte-identical to Claude). PermissionRequest (C1) fires `_report --event permission`, which CodexAdapter.parse classifies into waitReason == .permission — the SAME Needs-You 🔐 gate Claude reaches via its Notification/permission_prompt (M3 renders the row provider-neutrally). Codex telemetry stays the daemon-side rollout tail (adapter.parse returns nil for the SessionStart/Stop pushes), so those two hooks send no StatusReport; only PermissionRequest does.
